description: This Java source file defines the FindPhoneService class, an Android IntentService responsible for sending commands to trigger a sound alarm on a paired phone device via Google Play Services Wearable API. It manages connection setup with GoogleApiClient, toggles alarm states, and communicates with the wearable device to initiate or cancel the alarm.

classes.name: FindPhoneService
classes.description: An Android IntentService that creates a sound on the paired phone to find it. It manages GoogleApiClient connection and communicates with the wearable device to toggle an alarm.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes GoogleApiClient and sets up the Wearable API.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Handles incoming intents to toggle or cancel the alarm by communicating with the wearable via GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Callback when the connection to GoogleApiClient is suspended.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Callback when the connection to GoogleApiClient fails.
